edits.before: W the wave and his chest — the return pass is the damage; stand where the boomerang's geometry doubles.
edits.after: Swain has no threat until Nevermove lands — W the wave and his chest, sidestep the root, and Level 1 is yours.

edits.before: Full kit: the parkour opens — every wall on mid's border is now a gank route or an exit visa.
edits.after: Full kit: Nevermove is 12s at rank 1 — every miss opens a W-Q-auto bleed string he cannot answer.

edits.before: Bleed-string the contacts: W both passes, Q the gap, auto the third stack. The lane bleeds rent.
edits.after: His root down means free contact: W both passes, Q the gap, auto the third stack — he can't trade back.

edits.before: Shadow Assault online — the roam game doubles and the all-in wraps targets in a blade carousel.
edits.after: Demonic Ascension heals through your burst — an all-in into the drain feeds him; bait it and reset.

edits.before: First item spike: the full string one-rotations squishies. Shove and parkour — side lanes owe you taxes.
edits.after: First item spike: Dirk-Hydra bursts him before the drain ramps — force fights while his 120s R is down.

edits.before: Late Talon flanks from coordinates wards don't cover: R in, string the carry, blade-exit through the wall.
edits.after: Two items in, Soul Fragments and health items make him a drain-tank your burst can't delete — flank carries.

edits.before: - Swain Demonic Ascension: matchup-defining — His drain mode — disengage and reset the fight when it starts. Count it out loud if you must. - Your E Assassin's Path has one job: the moment it all goes wrong. - The R has one too: the moment it all goes right.
edits.after: - Demonic Ascension: 120s — his drain mode; disengage when it starts and all-in the long window after. - Nevermove: 12s at rank 1 — every miss is a free bleed string. - Vision of Empire: 22s. - Your R: 100s at rank 1 — spend it on kills, not poke.

edits.before: His drain mode — disengage and reset the fight when it starts. Its cooldown is the green light — wait for it.
edits.after: Rake's return pass deals bonus damage and slows — angle so both passes connect; that is most of your poke for free.

edits.before: W on the contact, Q the gap, auto for the bleed, walk through the return — three stacks of rent he paid for one trade.
edits.after: He steps up only to cast Q or E — punish the wind-up: land W, Q-blink the third stack, and back off before Nevermove returns.

edits.before: Q-leaping into a held CC for style — Talon without the gap-closer is a roamer stuck in traffic.
edits.after: An uncrashed wave feeds his passive souls and plates while you are gone — shove it into tower first.
